prompt: Freehand Chinese ink painting (xieyi) game sprite on transparent ground: calligraphic brush strokes that swell and taper, dry flying-white streaks, splashed wet ink that bleeds at its edges, and large areas left as bare paper. Black ink in five dilutions; the only colours are indigo-cyan (water, distance) and ink green (plants). No warm colour, no outline-and-fill, no airbrush. Orthographic side view, no cast shadow. SUBJECT: An arched stone bridge: one bold ink stroke for the flat deck, one for the arch ring, pale stone left almost as paper, moss at the springers.
